args.query: SELECT "group", SUM(conversions) AS conversions, SUM(users) AS users, CAST(SUM(conversions) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(users),0) AS conversion_rate FROM experiment_outcomes.csv GROUP BY "group" ORDER BY conversion_rate DESC, "group" ASC;
